title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit325, pure FP8 KV, 1.51M pool (1M ctx), uncapped exact MoE
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on six DGX Sparks at TP=6 with gr8 v1.2.0 using pure FP8 KV cache (KV_FORMAT=fp8, KVB=bf16, zero INT4 KV quantization), uncapped exact MoE routing (MOE_UNION_CAP=0, KL=0.00000), DFlash + MTP=2 drafting, and a 1,507,328-token FP8 KV pool (1M max context). Live-verified at 78.0 tok/s code, RealMark 1,236.1 Grade A, 959K needle recall, 4x235K (972K resident) multi-session stress, and a TP=6 K4 (bit390) option.

configs.label: TP=6 · bit325 FP8 KV
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: prompt + max_tokens · live-proven: 4x150K (616K resident, 99.95% cache), 4x235K (972K resident, 99.98% cache)
configs.notes: Measured 2026-11-26 on gr8 v1.2.0 (ab2eb95) across 6 DGX Sparks on a 200G RoCE v2 switch, GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages (0% thermal throttle). bit325 experts (v0.6 @ 3e388b45), pure FP8 KV (bin/g6m4, KV_FORMAT=fp8, KVB=bf16, CAP=1,507,328, 4,352 physical pages/rank, max_model_len=1,048,576, SHARE_LIMIT=32,768, SESS=8, GR8_KV_SHARE_PAGES=1), DFlash + MTP=2, PF_OWN=3 + QO_CACHE, uncapped exact MoE routing (MOE_UNION_CAP=0, KL=0.00000). Harness: gr8 bench/bench.py default level + RealMark (957f600, C=1/2/4 --probe, enable_thinking=false) + calibrated needles & multi-session stress. MemAvailable: 7.29-7.80 GiB post-boot, 6.56 GiB min during RealMark, 6.41 GiB min during 972K stress.

configs.label: TP=6 · K4 (bit390) FP8 KV
configs.notes: K4 quality option on 6 DGX Sparks: VARIANT=bit390 (3.90 bpw, ~60.0 GB/rank, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), pure FP8 KV (CAP=524,288, max_model_len=524,274, SHARE_LIMIT=32,768, SESS=8), DFlash + MTP=2, MOE_UNION_CAP=0, gr8 v1.2.0 (ab2eb95). Measured 2026-11-26 via gr8 bench/bench.py --quick. MemAvailable: 10.60-11.08 GiB post-boot, 10.41-10.92 GiB post-bench.
